implementation.localAcceptance: Camera and library use the same local acceptance path: crop/resize to JPEG, persist immutable bytes and a private document file, persist the scoped outbox, project onto Home/Plushie, then close the editor. No network response is awaited by the UI. Local disk failures retain the original recoverable crop/key.
implementation.backgroundSync: Account/pair/owner/toy-scoped serialized outbox, immutable request keys, capped exponential retry, hourly rate-limit backoff, foreground/relaunch resume, duplicate target lock, stale callback fencing and definitive-rejection rollback. Cloud quota, permission and Moment authorities are unchanged. OS-suspended apps resume work on foreground/relaunch; continuous background execution is not claimed.
implementation.receipt: Verified cloud receipt adopts the existing durable file without another encode/copy. Cache adoption failures cannot turn a committed upload into a generic save failure. Stale snapshots cannot replace a confirmed Doll receipt or undo its same-day target usage before an equal/newer cloud version is observed.
implementation.cloudRetention: Existing deployed-compatible SQL keeps one current room_photos row per pair/owner/doll/toy. Replacements retire the old private path into room_photo_garbage. Doll faces are not added to frame history. Existing cleanup protects current/active references, applies the one-hour safety grace, deletes Storage objects and only then acknowledges the queue. The configured hourly cleanup means obsolete objects can remain temporarily; immediate physical deletion is not claimed.
implementation.hearts: Squeeze and Bonk spawn two-second upward particles above the actual costume bounds/head centre, including the padded Skia coordinate space.
implementation.toySwitch: Removed the Toy updated banner, its state/effects/styles and its delayed normal-flow removal. Toy replacement has no transient banner-induced stage resize.
